title: Methyl eugenol protects the kidney from oxidative damage in mice by blocking the Nrf2 nuclear export signal through activation of the AMPK/GSK3beta axis.
authors: Kuang, Bai-Cheng; Wang, Zhi-Heng; Hou, Shuai-Heng; Zhang, Ji; Wang, Meng-Qin; Zhang, Jia-Si; Sun, Kai-Lun; Ni, Hai-Qiang; Gong, Nian-Qiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甲基丁香酚通过AMPK/GSK3beta轴阻断Nrf2核输出信号保护肾脏氧化损伤，虽涉及Nrf2核转位和分子对接，但核心是药物保护机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法上仅简单分子对接，无AI或MD模拟，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Disrupted redox homeostasis contributes to renal ischemia-reperfusion (IR) injury. Abundant natural products can activate nuclear factor erythroid-2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), thereby providing therapeutic benefits. Methyl eugenol (ME), an analog of the phenolic compound eugenol, has the ability to induce Nrf2 activity. In this study, we investigated the protective effects of ME against renal oxidative damage in vivo and in vitro. An IR-induced acute kidney injury (AKI) model was established in mice. ME (20 mg.kg(-1).d(-1), i.p.) was administered to mice on 5 consecutive days before IR surgery. We showed that ME administration significantly attenuated renal destruction, improved the survival rate, reduced excessive oxidative stress and inhibited mitochondrial lesions in AKI mice. We further demonstrated that ME administration significantly enhanced Nrf2 activity and increased the expression of downstream antioxidative molecules. Similar results were observed in vitro in hypoxia/reoxygenation (HR)-exposed proximal tubule epithelial cells following pretreatment with ME (40 mumol.L(-1)). In both renal oxidative damage models, ME induced Nrf2 nuclear retention in tubular cells. Using specific inhibitors (CC and DIF-3) and molecular docking, we demonstrated that ME bound to the binding pocket of AMPK with high affinity and activated the AMPK/GSK3beta axis, which in turn blocked the Nrf2 nuclear export signal. In addition, ME alleviated the development of renal fibrosis induced by nonfatal IR, which is frequently encountered in the clinic. In conclusion, we demonstrate that ME modulates the AMPK/GSK3beta axis to regulate the cytoplasmic-nuclear translocation of Nrf2, resulting in Nrf2 nuclear retention and thereby enhancing antioxidant target gene transcription that protects the kidney from oxidative damage.
abstract_zh: 破坏的氧化还原稳态有助于肾缺血再灌注（IR）损伤。大量天然产物能够激活核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2），从而提供治疗益处。甲基丁香酚（ME），一种酚类化合物丁香酚的类似物，具有诱导Nrf2活性的能力。在本研究中，我们在体内和体外探讨了ME对肾氧化损伤的保护作用。在小鼠中建立了IR诱导的急性肾损伤（AKI）模型。在IR手术前连续5天，对小鼠给予ME（20 mg.kg(-1).d(-1)，腹腔注射）。我们显示，ME给药显著减轻了AKI小鼠的肾破坏，提高了存活率，减少了过度氧化应激，并抑制了线粒体病变。我们进一步证明，ME给药显著增强了Nrf2活性，并增加了下游抗氧化分子的表达。在体外，对缺氧/复氧（HR）暴露的近端肾小管上皮细胞进行ME（40 mumol.L(-1)）预处理后，观察到了类似结果。在两种肾氧化损伤模型中，ME诱导了肾小管细胞中Nrf2的核滞留。使用特异性抑制剂（CC和DIF-3）和分子对接，我们证明ME以高亲和力结合AMPK的结合口袋，并激活AMPK/GSK3beta轴，进而阻断Nrf2核输出信号。此外，ME减轻了非致命性IR诱导的肾纤维化的发展，这在临床中经常遇到。总之，我们证明ME调节AMPK/GSK3beta轴以调控Nrf2的胞质-核转位，导致Nrf2核滞留，从而增强抗氧化靶基因的转录，保护肾脏免受氧化损伤。
